summary: Added cross-structure NF transfer lemmas (nf_extend_fwd/bwd, exist_transfer_const_env). Proved definitively that 1-var NF type does NOT determine 2-var NF type on constant environments, ruling out the simple backward proof approach. Backward direction still blocked on all 3 zones.

blockers.description: Backward direction of existPart_succ_n1_bypass at k>0 requires encoding 2-var NF quantifier conditions into the temporal formula. Three candidate approaches: (A) Enriched formula conjoining ih_exist formulas for each ssn : NormalForm sig (k'+1) 3 — exponentially large type makes enumeration impractical. (B) Prior compositionality theorem from Rabinovich Lemma 5.1 (~200-400 lines). (C) Constant-parent arity projection lemma showing 3-var existentials on [y,t,t] reduce to 2-var existentials on [y,t] at all depths — would solve Eq zone but not Until/Since.
what_tried: char_kp1 nf_x₀ as formula (single M₀ NF type) — forward direction fails because different witnesses can have different 1-var types
nf_x_eq (all witnesses share nf_x₀) — FALSE: different models can satisfy same 2-var sub_nf with different 1-var witness types
const_env_determined (1-var type determines 2-var on [t,t]) — FALSE: counterexample with models of different cardinality

nf_extend_fwd/bwd for cross-structure transfer — proved correctly but insufficient: gets depth-(k'+1) arity-2 from depth-(k'+2) arity-1, but need depth-(k'+1) arity-3 for quantifier conditions (one depth level short)
exist_transfer_const_env — proved correctly, transfers arity-2 existentials between models with same 1-var type
blockers.what_needed: Prior compositionality theorem (~200-400 lines) OR a formula construction that avoids NormalForm enumeration

key_decisions: nf_extend_fwd/bwd: standalone versions of component_extend_fwd/bwd from NEquivalence.lean — proved and compiling
exist_transfer_const_env: wraps nf_extend_fwd/bwd for constant-env existential transfer — proved and compiling
Restructured satisfiable case with M₀ witness NF type infrastructure (nf_2₀, h_nf_2₀_eq)
key_findings: nf_x_eq is FALSE: different models can satisfy same 2-var sub_nf with different 1-var types for the witness
const_env_determined is FALSE: 1-var type does NOT determine 2-var type on constant environments
Extension lemma loses one depth level per arity increase: depth-(k'+2) arity-1 → depth-(k'+1) arity-2 → depth-k' arity-3
The fundamental gap: compat_disj only encodes 1-var predicate compatibility, but backward direction needs 2-var quantifier conditions which involve 3-var existentials not captured by 1-var type
